paper_id: Wang et al. - 2010 - Multicast throughput for large scale cognitive networks
title: Multicast throughput for large scale cognitive networks
venue: Springer Science+Business Media (Mobile Networks and Applications or similar)
motivation: licensed spectrum remains idle while bandwidth demand increases; need opportunistic spectrum access without harming primary users
problem_framing: define achievable multicast throughput for cognitive network under priority constraint via TDR metric, unify unicast/broadcast results
key_insight: SaN achieves same order throughput as standalone if PaN tolerates constant TDR; preservation regions+power regulator protect PaN
method_signature: TDMA+multihop routing with preservation regions and power control for dual-network interference management
evaluation_criteria: TDR lower bound, IIF upper bound, total/minimum/avg per-session multicast throughput scaling
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: if PaN demands TDR=1 (no impact), SaN suffers arbitrary infinitesimal factor gap θ(n)=o(1) vs standalone
evidence_for_taste: most important constraint is that PaN does not alter its protocol
simple equal time-sharing can achieve the same order
not sufficient to maintain the priority
the characteristics of this paper is that we take account of all cases
the most challenging issue is to design a scheme for SaN to protect the throughput
we endow PaN with the right to determine the threshold
thinking_moves: 把优先级问题量化成可调阈值(TDR),让primary自己决定能容忍多少性能损失
证明最坏情况下secondary网络仍能达到standalone同阶吞吐量,来保证实用性
用preservation regions+power regulator构造interference隔离而非简单时间分配
扩展unicast结果到multicast时考虑所有n_s和n_d的取值,不假设特定范围
